mapper.select: select trunk_id as trunkId, max(trunk_code) as trunkCode, max(trunk_carrier) as carrier, count(1) as totalCalls, sum(case when is_connected = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as connectedCalls, sum(case when is_connected = '1' then 0 else 1 end) as failedCalls, round(sum(case when is_connected = '1' then 1 else 0 end) * 100 / count(1), 2) as connectRate, ifnull(sum(talk_duration), 0) as totalDuration, ifnull(round(sum(talk_duration) / nullif(sum(case when is_connected = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0)), 0) as acd, ifnull(round(avg(ring_duration)), 0) as avgRingDuration, ifnull(round(avg(nullif(mos, 0)), 2), 0) as avgMos, ifnull(round(avg(packet_loss), 2), 0) as avgPacketLoss from ai_call_dial_log where trunk_id is not null and dial_time >= #{beginTime} and dial_time < #{endTime} group by trunk_id

select ifnull(trunk_carrier, '00') as carrier, count(1) as totalCalls, sum(case when is_connected = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as connectedCalls, sum(case when is_connected = '1' then 0 else 1 end) as failedCalls, round(sum(case when is_connected = '1' then 1 else 0 end) * 100 / count(1), 2) as connectRate, ifnull(sum(talk_duration), 0) as totalDuration, ifnull(round(sum(talk_duration) / nullif(sum(case when is_connected = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0)), 0) as acd, ifnull(round(avg(nullif(mos, 0)), 2), 0) as avgMos from ai_call_dial_log where dial_time >= #{beginTime} and dial_time < #{endTime} group by ifnull(trunk_carrier, '00')

select count(1) as totalCalls, sum(case when is_connected = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as connectedCalls, ifnull(round(sum(case when is_connected = '1' then 1 else 0 end) * 100 / nullif(count(1), 0), 2), 0) as connectRate, ifnull(sum(talk_duration), 0) as totalDuration, ifnull(round(sum(talk_duration) / nullif(sum(case when is_connected = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0)), 0) as acd, sum(case when failover_count > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as failoverCalls, ifnull(round(avg(queue_wait_ms)), 0) as avgQueueWaitMs from ai_call_dial_log where dial_time >= curdate()
